summary: Bulk fax (up to 500 numbers) + regression fixes. Backend: new suite backend/tests/test_cloudivr_fax_bulk.py 11/11 PASS + previous test_cloudivr_fax.py 17/17 PASS (pricing assertion updated to include bulkMax=500) against the public URL; node harness js/tests/test_fax_service.js 37/37 PASS. Verified: bulk quote (recipients, pagesEach, pages = pages x recipients, free+paid split, cost = paid x $2), dedupe, invalid entries counted (invalid[], invalidCount), CSV/semicolon/space-separated parsing, 520 numbers -> 400 too_many, no valid -> 400 no_recipients, Bob 404, unauth 401, 500x3 pages -> 402 insufficient_balance and stage NOT consumed (re-quote with same stageId 200), stage from A used from B -> 410 (single + bulk), bulk send -> batch running -> 'done' with 5/5 delivered, stage reuse 410, bulk faxes absent from faxes[], cancel finished batch -> 409 not_running, cancel running batch -> cancelled with sent<total and delivered==sent, Bob cannot cancel Alice's batch, pending pages counted against free allowance. Inbox gets exactly one summary per batch ('Bulk fax finished' x2, 'Bulk fax stopped' x2), no per-fax spam. Frontend (Playwright desktop + 390px mobile): Bulk mode, count turns red with '— over the 500 limit' at 505, CSV load via fax-bulk-file-input (toast 'Loaded 3 numbers'), quote shows '10 numbers x 1 page', '10 pages · 10 free', Free; invalid-entry warning toast; 'Send to 10 numbers' -> toast + Bulk faxes card, batch Sending -> Finished (10/10 delivered) via 5s auto-refresh; Stop -> confirm dialog -> 'Bulk fax stopped' toast, status Stopped, Stop button gone, 11/40 sent; single fax regression (send, history auto-refreshes Queued->Delivered, file input reset after send, same file re-pickable), fax line toggle on/off with confirm (off state visible in light theme), Bob sees only his own number and no batches. Bot: code review found a CRITICAL TDZ bug (see below).

minor.issue: If the process restarts between the cursor $inc and dispatch() (or in dry-run, before the 3s simulated delivery fires), started+startFailed < cursor forever (or faxes stay 'queued'), so finishBatch never completes the batch: it stays 'running' forever, keeps the web page polling every 5s, and never sends a summary. resumeBatches cannot recover it. Consider a stale-claim sweep (e.g. mark dispatched-but-unrecorded slots as startFailed after N minutes).
Another user's batch id returns 409 not_running ('already finished') instead of 404 not_found; harmless but misleading.

Wallet is only checked up front (not reserved); paid pages are debited per delivery via forceWalletDebit, so spending the wallet elsewhere during a long batch can push it negative. Acceptable per spec but worth noting.

ui_bugs.issue: Stopped batches still say 'N waiting' (e.g. '11 sent · 11 delivered · 0 failed · 29 waiting'); for status 'cancelled' this should read 'N not sent'.

Polling only runs while a batch is 'running' (or single faxes are queued). Right after Stop the in-flight faxes are still delivering (showed '11 sent · 0 delivered') but the page stops refreshing; delivered count only updates after a manual reload. Keep polling while sent > delivered+failed.

fax-bulk-count counts every token with 3+ digits, so invalid entries (e.g. '12345') and duplicates are counted ('11 numbers' for 10 valid). The server quote is correct; client count is just an estimate.

critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL (bot, all 4 bots): TDZ ReferenceError 'Cannot access 'k' before initialization'. The early media handler in js/_index.js (~line 8475-8503) and faxBulkList (~line 30749, a hoisted function declaration in the same big handler closure) use `k.of(...)`, but the handler closure redeclares `const k = trans('k')` at ~line 9959. That inner `const k` shadows the module-level `k` (line 719) for the whole closure, so any use before line 9959 runs throws. Effects: (1) bulk list sent as .csv/.txt document -> faxBulkList sends '✅ N numbers added' then throws on fx.askDoc(...k.of([])) -> user gets '⚠️ That file could not be read. Paste the numbers instead.' (state already moved to cpFaxDoc, so it is confusing); (2) ANY fax document/photo upload in the bot (single AND bulk) hits line 8500 `...k.of([[label],[fx.btnCancel]])` after stage() and after setting action=cpFaxConfirm -> throws -> user sees '⚠️ That file could not be read. Send a PDF, JPG or PNG.' and never gets the quote/confirm button -> bot fax sending is effectively broken. Pasted list (text path at line 32297) is fine since it runs after line 9959. Reproduced the JS semantics with a minimal node script. Fix: in those early paths use `trans('k').of(...)` (trans is defined at ~8195) or a module-level alias (e.g. `const kb = k` at module scope near line 719) instead of `k`.
faxBulkList itself does not reference `info` or `a` (good); it uses send/set/state/faxService which are module-level and safe.
Bot cpFaxConfirm: after a sendBulk/sendStaged error (e.g. 402) the bot clears cpFaxStage even though the server kept the stage, so the user must re-upload after topping up (web keeps it). Minor UX.
Bot cpFaxBulkTo: a photo sent while waiting for the number list falls through silently (no hint to paste numbers / send .csv).
action_items: CRITICAL: fix the `k` TDZ in js/_index.js early media handler (line ~8500) and faxBulkList (askDoc send) — use trans('k') or a module-level alias; then re-test bot single fax upload and .csv/.txt bulk list
Show 'not sent' instead of 'waiting' for stopped batches in FaxBatches.js
Keep Fax page polling while any batch has sent > delivered+failed (post-Stop in-flight faxes)
Optional: stale-claim recovery for batches interrupted by restart; return 404 for cancel of another user's batch
